LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_MoltenStone.nodes.0.d: Retains original health, mitigation and 25% block chance. Later nodes require your successful block of an ordinary hostile external hit; shield absorption, armour, friendly and secondary hits do not count. Progression stays with the item.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_MoltenStone.nodes.1.d: A successful hostile block marks its attacker for 4 seconds, with one mark maximum, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on that enemy consumes the mark for 75 bonus damage. Does not automatically reflect damage. Base rewards: damage 75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_MoltenStone.nodes.2.d: After a successful hostile block, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Never heals you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_MoltenStone.nodes.3.d: After Molten Reprisal deals actual bonus damage, deal 25 damage to one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_MoltenStone.nodes.4.d: After Molten Reprisal deals actual bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. A fully absorbed or armoured reprisal grants no healing. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_MoltenStone.nodes.5.d: After Molten Succour actually heals an ally, gain 50 base shield points for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. No actual healing means no shield. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_MoltenStone.nodes.6.d: After Molten Succour actually heals an ally, store one counterattack for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Shield absorption cannot recharge it. Base rewards: damage 50.
